descriptions.w3d_s20_vector_all_ge_800f5894: Appears to return 1 when each of three floats in the first vector is greater than or equal to the matching float in the second.
descriptions.w3d_s20_point_in_rect_8010b594: Appears to test whether a point lies inside one of the integer rectangles of a global table, inclusive of its edges.
descriptions.w3d_s20_scan_high_nibbles_801b0b10: Appears to scan groups of bytes and return 7 when any byte has a high nibble set, otherwise 8.
descriptions.w3d_s20_evaluate_cubic_8019661c: Appears to evaluate a cubic polynomial of the value offset by a constant when the field is set, otherwise return a constant.
